props.name: state
props.meaning: Which state this is. An error is destructive, an empty state muted.

props.name: label
props.meaning: The line to show. It truncates, and carries itself as a `title`.

props.name: icon
props.meaning: The glyph in front of the line, drawn at `size-4`.

props.name: pad
props.meaning: The room around the line: `py-6` in a popup list, `py-10` in a body, and none under rows already drawn.
